python3 -c "
import parse, re
# Test the g type specifically with a value that doesn't have decimal
format_str = 'general numbers: {:g}'
p = parse.compile(format_str)
print('_expression:', repr(p._expression))
text = 'general numbers: 1'
match = re.match(p._expression, text)
if match:
    print('Match succeeded')
    print('Groups:', match.groups())
    # Now try to convert
    group_name = p._name_to_group_map.get('general_numbers') or 0
    print('Group name:', group_name)
    if group_name in p._type_conversions:
        conv = p._type_conversions[group_name]
        print('Conversion:', conv)
else:
    print('No match')
" 2>/dev/null
